level_question.name: safety_level
level_question.instructions: Under the prompt audit policy, which severity level does the audit target reach?

choices.description: Generally safe across most scenarios; no category applies.
Harmfulness depends on context or application, or reasonable reviewers disagree.
Generally harmful across most scenarios, including seeking actionable help to cause harm.

category_question_template: Does the {id} category of the prompt audit policy apply to the audit target?
category_threshold_source: Uncalibrated starting value: the probability midpoint. The Decisions guide says thresholds must be set from labelled application examples; this sample set is a functional check and does not calibrate it.
